source_review.notes: Reviewed current Intel, AMD uProf, Arm Neoverse, Linux perf, PAPI, Cachegrind, LLVM vectorizer, Google Benchmark and primary Roofline sources. Eight destinations returned HTTP 200 after current redirects; AMD's official page timed out under automated retrieval, and both canonical ACM DOI pages returned access-control responses while bibliographic identities were independently checked. The stale Roofline PDF endpoint was replaced before digest binding.

evidence: Checked line-number mapping, interval caveat, distinct footprint, dependent-latency lower-bound model, AMAT approximation, useful-byte ratio, working set, arithmetic intensity and MPKI definitions.
Separated logical address streams, virtual translation, physical/cache placement, PMU events and wall time.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Every equation is explicitly a scoped reasoning model rather than cycle-accurate hardware law.

evidence: Recomputed 16 sequential slots over four-slot lines as four unique lines.
Recomputed stride-four accesses as four accesses to four distinct lines.
Recomputed eight four-field AoS x-slots as eight modeled lines and eight SoA x-slots as two.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Line size and slot width are model inputs, not target claims.

evidence: Derived sequential ceil(n/q) line footprint under alignment/divisibility premises.
Compared precomputed independent addresses with successor-produced dependency edges.
Checked conditional miss-rate nesting and Roofline arithmetic-intensity dimensional meaning.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Miss rates, latency overlap and bandwidth are not inferred from footprint alone.

evidence: Reviewed cold/warm, fits/exceeds hierarchy, alignment/crossings, conflicts, prefetch pollution, MLP saturation, TLB/page faults, huge pages and NUMA first-touch.
Reviewed AoS/SoA confounding, packed/overaligned layout, false/true sharing, races, compiler elimination, PMU multiplex/speculation/skid and timing side channels.
Reviewed medical-device cold/fault/interrupt/DMA/hardware-identity boundaries.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: No universal layout ordering or performance ratio remains from legacy material.

evidence: Locality claims bind fields, order, working set, layout, machine and execution mode.
Counter-derived metrics bind PMU event identity, scope, multiplexing and denominator.
Layout comparisons preserve abstract results and equivalent work before causal interpretation.
invariant_checking.notes: Correctness, structural layout and target performance remain distinct evidence layers.

evidence: Reviewed footprint derivation by address intervals and unique line union.
Reviewed dependency graph argument for serialized versus overlap-capable accesses.
Reviewed false-sharing diagnosis requirements: distinct ownership, one coherence line, concurrent writes, traffic evidence and equivalent separation control.
proof_review.notes: No processor, cache simulator or constant-time program is formally verified.

evidence: AMAT, Roofline, working-set and line-footprint models state limitations.
Counter, simulation and wall-time evidence are labeled as different scopes.
Medical-device example names clinical, safety, security, human-factors, quality and regulatory review and claims none.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Local optimization evidence is not deployment assurance.

evidence: Python snippet passed exact five-line stdout, empty stderr and zero exit status.
The snippet emits evidence=line_footprint_model_not_cache_measurement.
Source retrieval limitations and the corrected Roofline endpoint are explicitly recorded.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No actual addresses, PMU counters, cache simulation, bandwidth, latency, vectorization or medical system were measured.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed locality, line utilization, hierarchy, mapping, dependencies, MLP, prefetch, latency/bandwidth, TLB/pages, AoS/SoA/AoSoA, false sharing, blocking, counters, benchmark design and side channels.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed target-pinned experiments, equivalent native implementations, generated-code inspection, raw PMU provenance, cold/warm workloads, affinity/topology, multiplex ratios, controls, rollout and hardware diversity.

pedagogical_review.notes: Corrects legacy overclaims, builds on DSE-004/005 without duplicating architecture or benchmarking programs, uses one exact footprint model, counters fourteen misconceptions, and supplies ten examples plus five matched exercises/answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner and pedagogical evidence only; no external microarchitecture, PMU, compiler, operating-system, concurrency, security, medical-device, clinical, safety, regulatory, quality or independent validation review is claimed. The chapter and finite model prove neither actual cache misses, timing, bandwidth, vectorization, constant-time behavior, medical safety, certification nor deployment fitness.
